annotations.title: Get daily history for one network metric

description: Returns the daily series for one network metric (one point per UTC day, with how many observations backed it), e.g. symbol=AKT metric=GPU_ACTIVE. Days with no observation are absent, never zero. The free tier serves the last 7 days and says so in window_notice; an X-API-Key header on the connection serves your tier's window. Read-only.

metric.description: Metric name exactly as get_network lists it, e.g. GPU_ACTIVE.

name: get_metric_history
title: Get daily history for one network metric
